column1: # Host ops `browser-glue` does not implement, for interfaces it WIRES.
# `scripts/check_wit_ops.py --check` fails when an op a wired interface
# declares is neither exported by the runtime registry nor listed here, when
# a line here names an interface / op the WIT does not declare, and when a
# line here names an op the runtime ALREADY implements (the allowance has
# served its purpose and must shrink).
# Why this file exists: `check_wit_surface.py` is interface-level, and `window`
# being wired hid `window.match-media` having no host export at all. The guest
# then read `(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` as `false` on every page, so
# hikari's AnimationProvider never suppressed animation. The lines below are
# the same class of hole, listed honestly rather than left silent.
# The interface-level inventory next to it (wit-surface-allow.tsv) says which
# interfaces are absent altogether; this file says which declared ops of an
# interface that IS wired have no implementation.
